{{Quote|Keep away from the prisoner, Commander.|Voleyy, to Wedge Antilles|<ref name="krytos" />}}
'''Voleyy''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Security guard/Legends|guard]] in the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Prison/Legends|detention center]] located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. In [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]], Voleyy arranged for [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] [[Commander/Legends|commander]] [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]], and [[Tycho Celchu/Legends|Tycho Celchu's]] [[Lawyer/Legends|lawyer]], [[Nawara Ven]], to visit Celchu in [[Unidentified Coruscant prison|prison]]. Voleyy opened the [[Transparisteel/Legends|transparisteel]] barrier that separated Celchu from his visitors but prohibited Antilles from having physical contact with his friend. When Ven asked Voleyy to leave the room, he complied.

==Biography==
{{Quote|I'm going to be right out there. Anything funny happens, and you'll be spending a lot of time with this traitor.|Voleyy, to Nawara Ven|<ref name="krytos" />}}
[[File:Celchu-TPAcover.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Tycho Celchu, an inmate under Voleyy's supervision]]
Voleyy was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as a [[Security guard/Legends|guard]] for a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Unidentified Coruscant prison|detention center]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="krytos" /> In [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[X-Wing: The Krytos Trap]]'' to [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]].</ref> [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] [[Executive officer/Legends|executive officer]] [[Tycho Celchu/Legends|Tycho Celchu]] was [[Prisoner/Legends|imprisoned]] while undergoing [[Trial of Tycho Celchu|trial]] for the supposed [[Death/Legends|murder]] of fellow Rogue [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]] during their [[Liberation of Coruscant (Galactic Civil War)|mission]] to retake Coruscant from the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="krytos" />

[[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]], the [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of the Rogues, and [[Nawara Ven]], Celchu's [[Lawyer/Legends|lawyer]], visited the [[Prison/Legends|prison]] and awaited Celchu in the visitation center. Voleyy opened the barrier made from [[Transparisteel/Legends|transparisteel]] that separated the prisoner from his visitors. However, when Antilles rose from his seat and walked toward Celchu, Voleyy enforced the prison's security rules. He brandished his [[Spray stick/Legends|Stokhli spray stick]], warning Antilles not to make physical contact with the prisoner. Voleyy then left the room when Ven asked for privacy to speak with his client.<ref name="krytos" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Voleyy isn't so bad, he just doesn't like things to get odd on his watch.|Tycho Celchu|<ref name="krytos" />}}
Voleyy was a man with a portly appearance. As a prison guard, he preferred to maintain order and disliked any unusual occurrences under his supervision. Voleyy showed his disdain for Celchu by calling him a [[Treason/Legends|traitor]] to the New Republic, although Celchu thought that Voleyy was not as bad as some of the other guards who were itching for a justification to show their patriotism against a prisoner charged with murder and treason.<ref name="krytos" />

==Equipment==
Voleyy carried a Stokhli spray stick in his duties as a prison guard.<ref name="krytos" />

==Behind the scenes==
Voleyy was created by [[Michael A. Stackpole]] for his [[1996]] novel ''[[X-Wing: The Krytos Trap]]'', the third volume in the [[Star Wars: X-Wing (novel series)|''Star Wars: X-Wing'']] series.<ref name="krytos" />
